reason: The font stack moved into the --font-sans token (variables.css). The computed value is the same stack.

The token is no longer defined on :root or in dark mode: nothing read it, and a value fixed at the root ignored later changes to --primary. The button hover rule in helpers/_effects.css now reads it with the button's own background as the fallback.

Button hover reads --button-hover, falling back to the button's base background (var(--element-bg, var(--primary))), so the default look is unchanged. :where() keeps it at one class of specificity so a consumer's own button reset wins (1.4.1).
